  • Experimental


NORAD ID: 40301
Int'l Code: 2014-070D
Launch date: November 6, 2014
Source: Japan (JPN)
Launch site: Orenburg, Russia (OREN)
Decay date: 2023-12-03

QSAT-EOS is a cube-shaped satellite, weighing about 110 pounds (50 kg). It was developed by a consortium of institutions led by Kyushu University and is designed to monitor disasters and vegetation from orbit.
